selection_rule: Every remaining unheld MATLAB, Objective-C or PHP record in the fixed cohorts, at all lengths; no substitutions.
findings: The six remaining MATLAB, Objective-C and PHP records cover signal feature selection/validation, an iOS entrypoint/delegate declaration and configuration/API specification adapters. All are Stack v3 observations; no cross-source quality comparison follows.

MATLAB feature selection ORs its same-channel proximity bounds, rejecting all candidates in that channel when granularity exceeds one. Its validation routine resets the prediction offset for every file, potentially reusing earlier predictions if directory-level preprocessing concatenates files. Dependencies, event geometry and split discipline remain unresolved; no accuracy was measured.

The Objective-C files delegate to UIKit and an application implementation outside these sampled files. Their generated-style all-rights-reserved headers coexist with permissive/Apache-2.0 dataset metadata; applicable notices remain unresolved, without inferring either permission or a licensing conflict.

The PHP adapter needs a valid mapping schema and alias contract; the specification generator needs compatible serialization/schema dependencies. Conditional failure paths are recorded separately from measured failures. Declarations and wrappers are not independently verified applications.
No new or reused verified origins for this batch; all existing family holds, source-use questions and original sampling factors remain intact.
boundaries: Full static assistant reading, not independent annotation or behavioral verification. No corpus code, signal-processing routines, external data, MATLAB/PHP interpreters, iOS application builds, dependency setup or tests executed.

All 218 original identities, token counts, language/license metadata and sampling weights retained; all 44 family holds preserved. No replacement selection, automatic repair, generic rejection filter or training admission.
No new acquisition, source-use approval, eligible yield, source ranking or GPU work. Exact offline replay validates bookkeeping and recorded inputs, not independent semantic judgments.
next: Finish the remaining 21 unheld records (18 Markdown and three CSS/SCSS), then reconcile provenance, notices, file roles and finite eligible supply in the existing qualification packet before selecting data-study arms.
